decisions.reason: The perfect binder sits close to the core finishing portfolio in an industry with growing turnover, so it likely meets the aspiration level, and the firm's slack lets it keep the product in the range without triggering problemistic search.

The fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's strategic push toward integrated automation and uses existing service and parts capabilities, so a shortfall large enough to prompt dropping it is unlikely.

The inline/nearline booklet maker supports the firm's expansion around digital print finishing and is a core category for its customers, so management would retain it as performing satisfactorily against aspirations.
